fact: A mission report dated 20 October 2021 records that in the Kananga and Ndesha health zones of Kasaï-Central facilities pass their monthly SNIS forms to the health zone central office, where the zone team keys them into DHIS2; it notes late encoding at Ndesha and discrepancies between the paper forms and DHIS2.
title: Rapport de la mission d’appui technique au monitorage mensuel des données de la ZS de Kananga mois de septembre 2021
publisher: Programme National de Lutte contre le Paludisme, Division Provinciale de la Santé du Kasaï Central (PMI Measure Malaria)
